objective: Review the repository homepage HTML for one small, evidence-based SEO or accessibility improvement. Produce a minimal patch proposal only. Do not change files outside index.html, do not claim Google indexing or live-browser testing, and explain the evidence and limitations. Use a safe Python script or another command that avoids delimiter conflicts when editing HTML. Do not use sed substitutions containing HTML tags or slash characters. If a command fails, read its exact error and choose a materially different command; never repeat the same failing command. Keep shell commands short and on one line where practical. Finish promptly with the required completion command once the minimal change is verified.
constraints: Proposal only: never apply changes to the source checkout, commit, merge, or deploy.
Do not modify workflows, credentials, secrets, admin authentication, or deployment configuration.
Do not invent test results, traffic data, search ranking, or indexing status.
The output must be a patch artifact for independent review; Captain approval is required before any future acceptance.
success_criteria: Every changed path is within the allowed path list.
Return a concise summary and explain why the improvement is justified by source evidence.
Do not claim browser testing or Google indexing was performed.
Keep the output as a patch proposal only and require independent checker review.
